title: UE actions upon the expiry of DataInactivityTimer

entities.name: Data Inactivity Timer
entities.description: Timer that expires when no data activity is detected, triggering UE state transition procedures.

entities.name: RRC Connected state
entities.description: Radio Resource Control connected state where the UE has an active connection with the network.

entities.name: RRC Idle state
entities.description: Radio Resource Control idle state where the UE does not have an active connection with the network.

entities.name: RRC connection failure release cause
entities.description: Release cause indicating failure in maintaining the RRC connection.

entities.name: Other release cause
entities.description: Generic release cause for transitions to RRC_IDLE state.

entities.name: Actions upon going to RRC_IDLE
entities.description: Procedure executed when transitioning from RRC_CONNECTED to RRC_IDLE state as specified in clause 5.3.11.

relations.description: Expiry of DataInactivityTimer triggers the procedure for transitioning to RRC_IDLE state.
The transition procedure uses 'RRC connection failure' as a release cause condition.
The transition procedure uses 'other' as a release cause condition.
Execution of the procedure results in the UE entering RRC_IDLE state.
The procedure requires the UE to be in RRC_CONNECTED state before execution.
